title: Prescribed coordinates lift across a nilpotent ring quotient
statement: Let φ:R→S be a surjective commutative-ring homomorphism with nilpotent kernel. Let M be a finite-free R-module, N an S-module, u:M→N a surjective φ-semilinear map, and θ:S tensor_R M≅N an S-linear isomorphism whose ordinary scalar-extension adjoint is u. For any natural r and prescribed S-linear coordinate equivalence e:N≃S^r, there is an R-linear equivalence e′:M≃R^r satisfying e(u(x))_j=φ(e′(x)_j) for every x and j.

source.place: Tag 0CQF, compatible-basis argument in the proof

proof.text: Lift the prescribed basis vectors through u and form the associated linear map R^r→M. By the adjunction equation for θ its scalar extension is the prescribed basis isomorphism. Choose a finite basis of M and lift the inverse reduced matrix. Both products differ from identity matrices by matrices in ker φ. If this ideal has exponent d, both error matrices have dth power zero, so finite geometric sums invert both products. The lifted basis map has a left and right inverse, which coincide. Its inverse gives e′. The reduction equality on basis vectors gives the required formula by semilinearity. The same computation covers r=0 and zero rings; no invariant-basis-number argument is required.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_nilpotent_finiteFree_basis_lift
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (φ : R →+* S) (hsurj : Function.Surjective φ)
    (hnil : IsNilpotent (RingHom.ker φ))
    (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (N : ModuleCat.{max u v} S)
    [Module.Free R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (u : M ⟶ (restrictScalars φ).obj N)
    (θ : (extendScalars φ).obj M ≅ N)
    (hu : Function.Surjective u)
    (hθ : (extendRestrictScalarsAdj φ).homEquiv M N θ.hom = u)
    (r : ℕ) (e : N ≃ₗ[S] (Fin r → S)) :
    ∃ e' : M ≃ₗ[R] (Fin r → R),
      ∀ (x : M) j, e (u x) j = φ (e' x j)
